areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: General objective not directly related; health infrastructure products and a digital health project contribute, but resource share is small and impact moderate.

areas.name: Early childhood and education
areas.reason: School and nursery construction and refurbishment contribute via a specific objective; small resource share and moderate impact.

areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: Cultural-space refurbishment and a covered market extension contribute; very small resource share and an indicator of limited design.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: General objective directly aligned; about 30% of resources on land regularization, waste, parks, drainage and road works; high expected impact.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Sports centre refurbishment and a citizenship facility contribute; very small resource share and an indicator of limited design.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Urban parks with preservation of springs and green-area expansion are only indirectly related, as the parks were mainly credited to urban-cities area.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Storm drainage network and flood-exposure indicator, but no information on resources allocated to drainage, which weakens the impact assessment.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Solar generation on public buildings and landfill biogas; low reach concentrated on public buildings and small resource share.

areas.name: Logistics and transport
areas.reason: Airport modernization supports regional integration and cargo and passenger flights; weak indicator and small resource share limit impact.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Administrative centre, fiscal modernization and digital city products; only one indicator, so moderate impact and limited adherence.

areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: No components, indicators or impacts directly tied to the area; land regularization was credited to urban-cities area instead.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: Expansion of local farming could not be tied to the covered-market works, which were credited to the creative-economy area.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: No related components or indicators; the digital-city product was credited to digital government.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: No direct link between the market works and job creation or productive inclusion of the poorest.
